mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 67 degrees at Verona City Hall. If you are out tonight, keep an eye out for the International Space Station at 8:27 PM. It will be visible for 4 minutes, rising in the Northwest over Middleton near Verona High School and traveling toward the Northeast near Madison by Home Depot, staying low near the horizon.

There are two major updates from City Hall. First, road maintenance crews will begin chip seal treatments on September 23, affecting Cross Country Road, parts of E Verona Ave, and the Liberty Business Park. Second, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to review several site plans and development projects, including new work at Sub-Zero and various properties in the Town of Verona.

There is plenty to do this week in the area. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard or Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli, the Dane County Farmers Market on the Square, or live music at Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, you can participate in the Bike the Barns fundraiser this Saturday at Badger Prairie County Park.

For this week's police report, we are highlighting an incident from September 5. An officer discovered multiple vehicles with cheese slices on their windshields in various neighborhoods, which was identified as a viral social media prank.
Currently, the Culver's of Verona location is closed for a remodel, so today's flavor of the day is not available.
